"""県×年のパネルに、処置（最低賃金の上がり幅）・結果（就業率の変化）・県の特徴を付ける"""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from common import RAW, DATA

p = pd.read_csv(RAW / "f01_panel.csv").sort_values(["code", "year"])
# 処置：前年からの最低賃金（暦年換算）の上がり幅を、2015年の短時間労働者の平均時給に対する%ptで表す
p["treat"] = p.groupby("code")["mw"].diff() / p["hourly_wage_yen"] * 100
p["treat_pct"] = p.groupby("code")["log_mw"].diff() * 100            # 参考：上昇率（%）
# 結果：就業率・完全失業率の前年差（%pt）
p["d_emp"] = p.groupby("code")["emp_rate"].diff()
p["d_unemp"] = p.groupby("code")["unemp_rate"].diff()
# 前年の動き（交絡の調整用）
p["lag_d_emp"] = p.groupby("code")["d_emp"].shift()
p["lag_d_jor"] = p.groupby("code")["jor"].diff().groupby(p["code"]).shift()

# 2015年の値（引き上げが続く前）
b = p[p.year == 2015].set_index("code")
base = pd.DataFrame({"bite": b["bite"], "wage15": b["hourly_wage_yen"], "emp15": b["emp_rate"],
                     "unemp15": b["unemp_rate"], "jor15": b["jor"], "logpop15": np.log(b["pop15"])})

# 65歳以上の割合（SSDSE-B、2015年度）
sb = pd.read_csv(RAW / "SSDSE-B-2026.csv", encoding="cp932", skiprows=[1])
sb = sb[sb["SSDSE-B-2026"].astype(str) == "2015"].copy()
sb["code"] = sb["Code"].str[1:3].astype(int)
base["age65"] = (sb.set_index("code")["A1303"] / sb.set_index("code")["A1101"] * 100)

# 産業別の従業者の割合（SSDSE-A-2021 の経済センサス2016年を県で合計）
sa = pd.read_csv(RAW / "SSDSE-A-2021.csv", encoding="cp932", skiprows=[1, 2])
sa["code"] = sa["SSDSE-A-2021"].str[1:3].astype(int)
g = sa.groupby("code")[["C2208", "C220837", "C220841", "C220847", "C220850", "C220836"]].sum()
for col, k in [("sh_manu", "C220837"), ("sh_retail", "C220841"), ("sh_food", "C220847"),
               ("sh_welfare", "C220850"), ("sh_constr", "C220836")]:
    base[col] = g[k] / g["C2208"] * 100

df = p.merge(base.drop(columns=["bite"]), left_on="code", right_index=True)
df = df[df.year >= 2010].dropna(subset=["treat", "d_emp", "lag_d_emp", "lag_d_jor"])
df.to_csv(DATA / "f17_panel.csv", index=False)
base.round(4).to_csv(DATA / "f17_pref_features.csv")
print(df.shape, df.year.min(), df.year.max())
print(df.groupby("year")[["treat", "treat_pct", "d_emp"]].agg(["mean", "std"]).round(3))
print(base.describe().round(2).T)

"""因果フォレスト（econml CausalForestDML）で、県×年ごとの効果を推定する"""
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold
from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor
from econml.dml import CausalForestDML, LinearDML
from common import DATA, RES, X_COLS, SEED

def nuis():
    return LGBMRegressor(n_estimators=300, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=8, min_child_samples=15,
                         subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, random_state=SEED, verbose=-1)

def sample(df, years="main"):
    if years == "main":   # コロナの3年（2020〜22）を除く
        return df[~df.year.isin([2020, 2021, 2022])].copy()
    if years == "pre":    return df[df.year <= 2019].copy()
    if years == "post":   return df[df.year >= 2016].copy()
    if years == "all":    return df.copy()
    raise ValueError(years)

def arrays(d, outcome="d_emp"):
    W = pd.concat([pd.get_dummies(d.year, prefix="y", drop_first=True).astype(float),
                   d[["lag_d_emp", "lag_d_jor"]]], axis=1)
    return d[outcome].values, d["treat"].values, d[X_COLS].values, W.values, d["code"].values

def fit_cf(d, outcome="d_emp", leaf=10, depth=None, n=2000, seed=SEED):
    Y, T, X, W, g = arrays(d, outcome)
    cf = CausalForestDML(model_y=nuis(), model_t=nuis(), cv=GroupKFold(5), n_estimators=n,
                         min_samples_leaf=leaf, max_depth=depth, max_samples=0.45, honest=True,
                         inference=True, random_state=seed)
    cf.fit(Y, T, X=X, W=W, groups=g, cache_values=True)
    return cf

def ols_fd(d, outcome="d_emp"):
    """参考：前年差の回帰（年効果つき、県クラスター）"""
    Y, T, X, W, g = arrays(d, outcome)
    Z = sm.add_constant(np.column_stack([T, W]))
    r = sm.OLS(Y, Z).fit(cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={"groups": g})
    return r.params[1], r.bse[1]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA / "f17_panel.csv")
    d = sample(df, "main")
    cf = fit_cf(d)
    Y, T, X, W, g = arrays(d)
    ate = cf.ate_inference(X=X)
    a_lo, a_hi = ate.conf_int_mean(alpha=0.05)
    tau = cf.effect(X); lo, hi = cf.effect_interval(X, alpha=0.05)
    d["tau"], d["tau_lo"], d["tau_hi"] = tau, lo, hi
    # 線形 DML（効果は一定）と前年差の回帰
    ld = LinearDML(model_y=nuis(), model_t=nuis(), cv=GroupKFold(5), random_state=SEED)
    ld.fit(Y, T, X=None, W=np.column_stack([X, W]), groups=g)
    lsi = ld.ate_inference(); lci = lsi.conf_int_mean(alpha=0.05)
    ld_pt = float(np.ravel(lsi.mean_point)[0]); ld_ci = (np.ravel(lci[0])[0], np.ravel(lci[1])[0])
    b, se = ols_fd(d)
    # 県ごとの平均効果
    pref = d.groupby(["code", "pref"]).agg(tau=("tau", "mean"), tau_lo=("tau_lo", "mean"), tau_hi=("tau_hi", "mean"),
                                           bite=("bite", "first")).reset_index()
    pref["ci_excl0"] = (pref.tau_lo > 0) | (pref.tau_hi < 0)
    pref.round(4).to_csv(RES / "pref_effects.csv", index=False)
    d[["code", "pref", "year", "treat", "d_emp", "tau", "tau_lo", "tau_hi"]].round(5).to_csv(RES / "obs_effects.csv", index=False)
    # 特徴量の重要度
    imp = pd.Series(cf.feature_importances_, index=X_COLS).sort_values(ascending=False)
    imp.round(4).to_csv(RES / "feature_importance.csv", header=["importance"])
    # 残差（交差適合）を使った検証：BLP と GATES（予測効果の4分位）
    yr, tr = cf.residuals_[0].ravel(), cf.residuals_[1].ravel()
    # 予測効果は、県のグループごとに外した森で出す（自分を学習に使わない）
    tau_cv = np.zeros(len(d))
    for k, (tr_i, te_i) in enumerate(GroupKFold(5).split(X, groups=g)):
        sub = d.iloc[tr_i]
        m = fit_cf(sub, n=1000, seed=SEED + k)
        tau_cv[te_i] = m.effect(X[te_i])
    d["tau_cv"] = tau_cv
    cen = tau_cv - tau_cv.mean()
    blp = sm.OLS(yr, np.column_stack([tr, tr * cen])).fit(cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={"groups": g})
    d["q"] = pd.qcut(tau_cv, 4, labels=[1, 2, 3, 4])
    gates = []
    for q, sub in d.assign(yr=yr, tr=tr).groupby("q"):
        r = sm.OLS(sub.yr, sub.tr).fit(cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={"groups": sub.code})
        gates.append({"q": int(q), "pred_mean": sub.tau_cv.mean(), "actual": r.params.iloc[0], "se": r.bse.iloc[0], "n": len(sub)})
    gates = pd.DataFrame(gates); gates["lo"] = gates.actual - 1.96 * gates.se; gates["hi"] = gates.actual + 1.96 * gates.se
    gates.round(4).to_csv(RES / "gates.csv", index=False)
    # 上位4分の1と下位4分の1の特徴の比較
    d["grp"] = np.where(d.q == 4, "下がりにくい側（予測の上位25%）", np.where(d.q == 1, "下がりやすい側（予測の下位25%）", "中間"))
    comp = d[d.grp != "中間"].groupby("grp")[X_COLS].mean().T
    comp.round(3).to_csv(RES / "high_low_compare.csv")
    d.drop(columns=["grp"]).to_csv(DATA / "f17_panel_with_tau.csv", index=False)
    out = {"n": len(d), "n_pref": int(d.code.nunique()), "years": sorted(d.year.unique().tolist()),
           "ate": float(ate.mean_point), "ate_lo": float(np.ravel(a_lo)[0]), "ate_hi": float(np.ravel(a_hi)[0]),
           "linear_dml": ld_pt, "linear_dml_ci": [float(ld_ci[0]), float(ld_ci[1])],
           "ols_fd": float(b), "ols_fd_ci": [float(b - 1.96 * se), float(b + 1.96 * se)],
           "tau_sd": float(tau.std()), "tau_p10": float(np.percentile(tau, 10)), "tau_p90": float(np.percentile(tau, 90)),
           "share_obs_ci_excl0": float(((lo > 0) | (hi < 0)).mean()),
           "n_pref_ci_excl0": int(pref.ci_excl0.sum()),
           "blp_mean": float(blp.params[0]), "blp_mean_se": float(blp.bse[0]),
           "blp_het": float(blp.params[1]), "blp_het_se": float(blp.bse[1]), "blp_het_p": float(blp.pvalues[1]),
           "corr_tau_cv_full": float(np.corrcoef(tau, tau_cv)[0, 1]),
           "treat_sd_within_year": float(d.groupby("year").treat.std().mean())}
    json.dump(out, open(RES / "main.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
    print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)); print(imp.round(3)); print(gates.round(3)); print(comp.round(2))
    print(pref.sort_values("tau").round(3).to_string())

"""頑健性：ハイパーパラメータ・期間・結果の指標・乱数の種・処置の入れ替え（プラセボ）"""
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold
from common import DATA, RES, X_COLS, SEED
import importlib; m = importlib.import_module("02_forest")

df = pd.read_csv(DATA / "f17_panel.csv")
main = pd.read_csv(RES / "pref_effects.csv").set_index("code")["tau"]

def run(label, d, outcome="d_emp", cv=False, **kw):
    cf = m.fit_cf(d, outcome=outcome, **kw)
    Y, T, X, W, g = m.arrays(d, outcome)
    ate = cf.ate_inference(X=X); lo, hi = ate.conf_int_mean(alpha=0.05)
    tau = cf.effect(X)
    yr, tr = cf.residuals_[0].ravel(), cf.residuals_[1].ravel()
    cen = tau - tau.mean()
    blp = sm.OLS(yr, np.column_stack([tr, tr * cen])).fit(cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={"groups": g})
    pt = pd.Series(tau, index=d.code.values).groupby(level=0).mean()
    rho = spearmanr(pt.reindex(main.index), main).correlation
    imp = pd.Series(cf.feature_importances_, index=X_COLS).sort_values(ascending=False)
    hp = np.nan
    if cv:   # 県のグループごとに外した森で予測した効果で BLP（自分を学習に使わない）
        tcv = np.zeros(len(d))
        for k, (a, b) in enumerate(GroupKFold(5).split(X, groups=g)):
            tcv[b] = m.fit_cf(d.iloc[a], outcome=outcome, n=1000, seed=SEED + k, **kw).effect(X[b])
        c2 = tcv - tcv.mean()
        hp = float(sm.OLS(yr, np.column_stack([tr, tr * c2])).fit(cov_type="cluster", cov_kwds={"groups": g}).pvalues[1])
    r = {"設定": label, "n": len(d), "平均効果": float(ate.mean_point), "下限": float(np.ravel(lo)[0]), "上限": float(np.ravel(hi)[0]),
         "効果のばらつき（SD）": float(tau.std()), "BLP p値（同じデータで予測）": float(blp.pvalues[1]), "BLP p値（県を外して予測）": hp,
         "県の効果の順位相関（基本と）": float(rho), "重要度1位": imp.index[0]}
    print(r); return r

rows = []
base = m.sample(df, "main")
rows.append(run("基本（2010〜25年、2020〜22年を除く）", base, cv=True))
rows.append(run("葉の最小サイズ 5", base, leaf=5))
rows.append(run("葉の最小サイズ 20", base, cv=True, leaf=20))
rows.append(run("木の深さ 最大4", base, depth=4))
for s in [1, 2, 3]:
    rows.append(run(f"乱数の種を変える（{s}）", base, seed=SEED + 100 * s))
rows.append(run("2010〜19年だけ（コロナ前）", m.sample(df, "pre")))
rows.append(run("2016〜25年（2020〜22年を除く）", m.sample(df, "post").query("year not in [2020,2021,2022]")))
rows.append(run("2020〜22年も含める", m.sample(df, "all")))
rows.append(run("結果を完全失業率の前年差にする", base, outcome="d_unemp"))
# プラセボ：同じ年の中で、処置（上がり幅）を県の間でシャッフル
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
for k in range(3):
    pb = base.copy()
    pb["treat"] = pb.groupby("year")["treat"].transform(lambda s: rng.permutation(s.values))
    rows.append(run(f"プラセボ：年の中で上がり幅をシャッフル（{k+1}）", pb, cv=True))
out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
out.round(4).to_csv(RES / "robustness.csv", index=False)
print(out.round(3).to_string())

"""01 データの取得

使うデータ（data/raw/ に 2026-10-26 時点のものを同梱）
- 景気動向指数 個別系列（内閣府 経済社会総合研究所）https://www.esri.cao.go.jp/jp/stat/di/di.html
    一致系列 *ci2.xlsx・先行系列 *ci1.xlsx・CI *ci.xlsx（2026年10月公表、2026年8月分まで）
    → F13 と同じファイル。ブラウザ内（SheetJS）で読んで行ごとの配列にしたものが f13_ci.json
- 労働力調査（完全失業率・季節調整値）：F13 で作った月次表 f13_monthly.csv の u_sa 列
- 四半期別GDP速報（内閣府）2026年4-6月期 2次速報 実質季節調整系列
    https://www.esri.cao.go.jp/jp/sna/data/data_list/sokuhou/files/2026/qe262_2/tables/gaku-jk2622.csv
    → 国内総生産(支出側) の列だけを gdp_real_sa.csv に（1994年1-3月期〜2026年4-6月期、2020暦年連鎖価格、10億円）
- 景気基準日付（内閣府）https://www.esri.cao.go.jp/jp/stat/di/hiduke.html → cycle_dates.csv（第8〜16循環の山と谷）

コンテナから内閣府のサイトに直接つながらない環境だったので、ブラウザで取得したものを置いている。
直接つながる環境では --download で GDP の CSV を取り直せる（景気動向指数は F13 の 01_取得.py を参照）。
"""
import sys, csv, io, re, urllib.request
from common import RAW

GDP_URL = "https://www.esri.cao.go.jp/jp/sna/data/data_list/sokuhou/files/2026/qe262_2/tables/gaku-jk2622.csv"


def fetch_gdp(url=GDP_URL):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60) as r:
        t = r.read().decode("shift_jis")
    out, y = [], None
    for line in t.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'^(\d{4})?/?\s*(\d+)-\s*(\d+)\.,"?([-\d,\.]+)', line)
        if m:
            if m.group(1):
                y = int(m.group(1))
            q = int(m.group(3)) // 3
            out.append((f"{y}Q{q}", float(m.group(4).replace(",", ""))))
    with open(RAW / "gdp_real_sa.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f); w.writerow(["quarter", "gdp_real_sa"]); w.writerows(out)
    print("saved gdp_real_sa.csv", len(out))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if "--download" in sys.argv:
        fetch_gdp()
    else:
        print("data/raw/ の同梱データを使います（GDP を取り直すときは --download）")

"""02 整形：月次パネル data/monthly_panel.csv（変換後）と data/gdp_q.csv（前期比）を作る"""
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from common import RAW, DATA, SERIES, START


def ci_table(key):
    d = json.loads((RAW / "f13_ci.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    rows = d[key]
    out = {}
    for r in rows:
        if len(r) > 3 and isinstance(r[1], (int, float)) and isinstance(r[2], (int, float)):
            out[pd.Timestamp(int(r[1]), int(r[2]), 1)] = r
    return out


def main():
    tabs = {"ci2": ci_table("1026ci2.xlsx"), "ci1": ci_table("1026ci1.xlsx")}
    f13 = pd.read_csv(RAW / "f13_monthly.csv", parse_dates=["month"]).set_index("month")
    raw, tr = {}, {}
    for name, src, col, how, lag, grp in SERIES:
        if src == "f13":
            s = f13[col].astype(float)
        else:
            s = pd.Series({t: (float(r[col]) if col < len(r) and isinstance(r[col], (int, float)) else np.nan)
                           for t, r in tabs[src].items()})
        s = s.sort_index()
        raw[name] = s
        if how == "dlog":
            x = 100 * np.log(s).diff()
        elif how == "diff":
            x = s.diff()
        else:
            x = s
        tr[name] = x
    raw = pd.DataFrame(raw)
    panel = pd.DataFrame(tr)
    # 消費者態度指数は 2001年10月以前は四半期の値を線形補間したもの → 2001年11月より前は欠測にする
    panel.loc[:"2001-11-01", "消費者態度指数"] = np.nan
    panel = panel.loc[START:]
    panel.index.name = "month"
    panel.to_csv(DATA / "monthly_panel.csv")
    raw.loc[START:].to_csv(DATA / "monthly_levels.csv", index_label="month")

    g = pd.read_csv(RAW / "gdp_real_sa.csv")
    g["q"] = pd.PeriodIndex(g["quarter"], freq="Q")
    g = g.set_index("q")["gdp_real_sa"]
    gq = 100 * np.log(g).diff()
    gq.index = gq.index.to_timestamp(how="end").normalize().to_period("M").to_timestamp()  # 四半期の最後の月
    gq.name = "gdp_qoq"
    gq.dropna().to_csv(DATA / "gdp_q.csv", index_label="month")
    print(panel.tail(3).T)
    print("panel", panel.shape, panel.index.min(), panel.index.max(), "gdp", gq.dropna().shape, gq.index.max())
    print(panel.notna().sum())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""03 分析：
(1) 全期間で DFM を推定し、共通因子・因子負荷量・景気の山谷との対応を見る
(2) 2008Q1〜2026Q2 の各四半期について、四半期の1・2・3か月目の月末と、四半期の翌月末の4時点で
    その時点に出ているデータだけで GDP 前期比を推定（疑似リアルタイム）。毎回推定し直す
(3) AR(1)・過去平均と比べる（RMSE・Diebold–Mariano 検定）
(4) 2026Q3 のナウキャスト（2026年8月末までのデータ）"""
import sys, json
from multiprocessing import Pool
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from common import RES, DATA, SERIES, SEED
from dfm import load, vintage, fit_nowcast, ar_nowcast, mean_nowcast

np.random.seed(SEED)
P, G = load()
ALL = [s[0] for s in SERIES]
COIN = [s[0] for s in SERIES if s[5] == "一致"]
NOFIN = [c for c in ALL if c not in ("日経商品指数", "マネーストック（前年比）", "株価（TOPIX）", "長期金利")]
VNAMES = ["1か月目", "2か月目", "3か月目", "翌月"]
EVAL_Q = pd.period_range("2008Q1", "2026Q2", freq="Q")
COVID_Q = pd.period_range("2020Q1", "2021Q2", freq="Q")


def one(args):
    q, vi, cols, k, mask = args
    V = q.asfreq("M", how="start") + vi  # vi=0..3 → 1か月目末..翌月末
    z, gv = vintage(P, G, V, cols, mask)
    try:
        dfm, _ = fit_nowcast(z, gv, q, k=k)
    except Exception as e:
        dfm = np.nan
    ar, h = ar_nowcast(gv, q)
    return dict(q=str(q), vint=VNAMES[vi], dfm=dfm, ar=ar, ar_h=h, mean=mean_nowcast(gv), actual=float(G.get(q, np.nan)))


def run(name, cols, k=1, mask=None, quarters=EVAL_Q):
    jobs = [(q, vi, cols, k, mask) for q in quarters for vi in range(4)]
    with Pool(2) as pool:
        out = pool.map(one, jobs)
    df = pd.DataFrame(out)
    df.to_csv(RES / f"nowcast_{name}.csv", index=False)
    return df


def dm(e1, e2, h=1):
    d = e1 ** 2 - e2 ** 2
    d = d[~np.isnan(d)]
    n = len(d)
    gam = [np.mean((d[:n - l] - d.mean()) * (d[l:] - d.mean())) for l in range(h)]
    var = (gam[0] + 2 * sum(gam[1:])) / n
    st = d.mean() / np.sqrt(var)
    st *= np.sqrt((n + 1 - 2 * h + h * (h - 1) / n) / n)
    return float(st), float(2 * stats.t.sf(abs(st), n - 1))


def summarize(df, label, exclude_covid=False):
    d = df.copy()
    if exclude_covid:
        d = d[~d["q"].isin([str(q) for q in COVID_Q])]
    rows = []
    for v in VNAMES:
        x = d[d.vint == v]
        e_d, e_a, e_m = x.dfm - x.actual, x.ar - x.actual, x["mean"] - x.actual
        st, p = dm(e_d.values, e_a.values)
        rows.append(dict(設定=label, 時点=v, n=int(e_d.notna().sum()),
                         RMSE_DFM=np.sqrt(np.nanmean(e_d ** 2)), RMSE_AR=np.sqrt(np.nanmean(e_a ** 2)),
                         RMSE_平均=np.sqrt(np.nanmean(e_m ** 2)), MAE_DFM=np.nanmean(abs(e_d)), MAE_AR=np.nanmean(abs(e_a)),
                         比_DFM対AR=np.sqrt(np.nanmean(e_d ** 2)) / np.sqrt(np.nanmean(e_a ** 2)),
                         符号一致_DFM=np.mean(np.sign(x.dfm) == np.sign(x.actual)),
                         符号一致_AR=np.mean(np.sign(x.ar) == np.sign(x.actual)),
                         DM統計量=st, DM_p=p))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def full_sample():
    z, gv = vintage(P, G, P.index.max(), ALL)
    nc, res = fit_nowcast(z, gv, "2026Q3", k=1)
    f = res.factors.smoothed.iloc[:, 0]
    f.index = f.index.astype(str)
    # 因子の向き：鉱工業生産の負荷量が正になるように
    lo = {c: float(res.params[f"loading.0->{c}"]) for c in ALL}
    lo["GDP"] = float(res.params["loading.0->GDP"])
    sign = 1 if lo["鉱工業生産"] > 0 else -1
    f = f * sign
    lo = {k: v * sign for k, v in lo.items()}
    pd.DataFrame({"factor": f}).to_csv(RES / "factor_full.csv", index_label="month")
    pd.Series(lo).to_csv(RES / "loadings_full.csv", header=["loading"])
    # 景気動向指数（一致）の前月比との相関
    lev = pd.read_csv(DATA / "raw" / "f13_monthly.csv", parse_dates=["month"]).set_index("month")
    ci = 100 * np.log(lev["ci_coin"]).diff()
    ci.index = ci.index.to_period("M").astype(str)
    j = pd.concat([f.rename("f"), ci.rename("ci")], axis=1).dropna()
    j3 = j.rolling(3).mean().dropna()
    # 後退期（山の翌月〜谷）
    cyc = pd.read_csv(DATA / "raw" / "cycle_dates.csv")
    rec = pd.Series(False, index=pd.period_range("1994-01", P.index.max(), freq="M"))
    peaks = cyc[cyc.type == "peak"].month.tolist()
    troughs = cyc[cyc.type == "trough"].month.tolist()
    for pk in peaks:
        tr = [t for t in troughs if t > pk]
        if tr:
            rec.loc[pd.Period(pk, "M") + 1: pd.Period(tr[0], "M")] = True
    rec.index = rec.index.astype(str)
    f3 = f.rolling(3).mean()
    jj = pd.concat([f3.rename("f3"), rec.rename("rec")], axis=1).dropna(); jj["rec"] = jj["rec"].astype(bool)
    out = dict(
        corr_factor_ci=float(j.corr().iloc[0, 1]), corr_factor_ci_3m=float(j3.corr().iloc[0, 1]),
        recession_months=int(jj.rec.sum()), share_neg_in_recession=float((jj[jj.rec].f3 < 0).mean()),
        share_neg_in_expansion=float((jj[~jj.rec].f3 < 0).mean()),
        mean_f3_recession=float(jj[jj.rec].f3.mean()), mean_f3_expansion=float(jj[~jj.rec].f3.mean()),
        nowcast_2026Q3_full=nc, llf=float(res.llf),
    )
    # 四半期ごとに因子の3か月平均と GDP の相関
    fq = f.copy(); fq.index = pd.PeriodIndex(fq.index, freq="M").asfreq("Q")
    fq = fq.groupby(level=0).mean()
    jq = pd.concat([fq.rename("f"), G.rename("g")], axis=1).dropna()
    out["corr_factor_gdp_q"] = float(jq.corr().iloc[0, 1])
    jq2 = jq[~jq.index.isin(COVID_Q)]
    out["corr_factor_gdp_q_excovid"] = float(jq2.corr().iloc[0, 1])
    rec.to_csv(RES / "recession_months.csv", header=["recession"], index_label="month")
    return out


def live_updates():
    """2026Q3 を、7月末〜9月末（実際は8月末までのデータ）の各時点で推定"""
    rows = []
    for V in ["2026-07", "2026-08"]:
        z, gv = vintage(P, G, V, ALL)
        v, _ = fit_nowcast(z, gv, "2026Q3")
        ar, h = ar_nowcast(gv, "2026Q3")
        rows.append(dict(時点=V + "末", DFM=v, AR=ar))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

"""ダイナミックファクターモデル（月次＋四半期）とナウキャストの共通部分"""
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.dynamic_factor_mq import DynamicFactorMQ
from statsmodels.tsa.ar_model import AutoReg
from common import DATA, SERIES

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
LAG = {s[0]: s[4] for s in SERIES}


def load():
    p = pd.read_csv(DATA / "monthly_panel.csv", parse_dates=["month"], index_col="month")
    p.index = p.index.to_period("M")
    g = pd.read_csv(DATA / "gdp_q.csv", parse_dates=["month"], index_col="month")["gdp_qoq"]
    g.index = g.index.to_period("M").asfreq("Q")
    return p, g


def vintage(p, g, V, cols, mask=None):
    """V（月末時点）で手に入るデータだけを残す。p は月次、g は四半期（前期比）"""
    V = pd.Period(V, "M")
    z = p[cols].copy()
    for c in cols:
        z.loc[z.index > V - LAG[c], c] = np.nan
    if mask is not None:
        z.loc[mask[0]:mask[1], :] = np.nan
    z = z.loc[:V]
    gv = g.copy()
    # 四半期 q の GDP（1次速報）は q の最後の月の2か月後の半ばに出る → その月末から使える
    rel = (gv.index.asfreq("M", how="end") + 2)
    gv = gv[rel <= V]
    return z, gv


def fit_nowcast(z, gv, target_q, k=1, factor_orders=2, maxiter=300):
    """target_q の GDP 前期比を推定する。データの標準化はその時点のデータだけで行う"""
    tq = pd.Period(target_q, "Q")
    end_m = tq.asfreq("M", how="end")
    idx = pd.period_range(z.index.min(), max(end_m, z.index.max()), freq="M")
    z = z.reindex(idx)
    mu, sd = z.mean(), z.std()
    zz = (z - mu) / sd
    gq_idx = pd.period_range(gv.index.min(), tq, freq="Q")
    gg = gv.reindex(gq_idx)
    gm, gs = gg.mean(), gg.std()
    gz = ((gg - gm) / gs).to_frame("GDP")
    # 月次の開始より前の四半期は落とす
    gz = gz[gz.index.asfreq("M", how="start") >= zz.index.min()]
    if k == 1:
        factors = 1
    else:
        factors = k
    mod = DynamicFactorMQ(zz, endog_quarterly=gz, factors=factors, factor_orders=factor_orders,
                          idiosyncratic_ar1=True, standardize=False)
    res = mod.fit(disp=False, maxiter=maxiter)
    pred = res.get_prediction(information_set="smoothed").predicted_mean
    v = pred.loc[end_m, "GDP"] * gs + gm
    return float(v), res


def ar_nowcast(gv, target_q, p=1):
    """AR(p) で target_q の前期比を予測（手に入る最後の四半期から何期先か）"""
    tq = pd.Period(target_q, "Q")
    y = gv.dropna()
    h = (tq - y.index.max()).n
    m = AutoReg(y.values, lags=p, trend="c").fit()
    f = m.forecast(h)
    return float(f[-1]), h


def mean_nowcast(gv):
    return float(gv.dropna().mean())

title: F19 小さな町の検診受診率はどこまで信用できるか？（小地域推定：Fay–Herriot モデル）
data_sec:
| データ | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 地域保健・健康増進事業報告 健康増進編 市区町村表 第20-1表（令和3〜6年度） | 大腸がん検診の対象者数・受診者数のうち「（再掲）国民健康保険の被保険者」、40〜69歳。e-Stat の CSV（statInfId 000040038221・000040165455・000040262026・000040423652） |
| SSDSE-A-2026（統計センター） | 共変量：65歳以上の割合、可住地人口密度（対数）、人口1万人あたりの一般診療所数・一般病院数、第1次産業就業者の割合、単独世帯の割合 |
| 行政区域の簡略版 TopoJSON（smartnews-smri/japan-topography、国土数値情報 行政区域 2021 をもとにしたもの、CC BY 4.0） | 地図だけに使用 |

- 設計では市町村国保の「特定健診」の受診率を使う予定だった。厚生労働省の公表は都道府県別・保険者の種類別までで、市町村国保ごとの表が見つからなかった。そこで設計の代替案どおり、市区町村ごとに対象者数と受診者数がそろう「大腸がん検診（国保の被保険者）」に切り替えた
- 政令市は市全体の1行。「…」（計数不詳）の町と対象者0の町は除いた。2023年度は1,679市区町村
- 「-」は0として扱った。受診者0の町（2023年度は4町）は報告の仕方の違いかもしれないので、除いた版も頑健性で見た
src_sec:
- 厚生労働省「地域保健・健康増進事業報告」（e-Stat、https://www.e-stat.go.jp/stat-search/files?toukei=00450025 ）を加工して作成
- 独立行政法人統計センター「SSDSE-A-2026」を加工して作成
- 国土交通省「国土数値情報（行政区域データ）」をもとに smartnews-smri/japan-topography が作成した簡略版（CC BY 4.0）を加工して作成
issue_sec:
- 受診率の違いの原因は分からない。人口密度などとの関係は「条件をそろえた関連」で、因果ではない
- 町の取り組みの評価にはならない。検診は職場や人間ドックでも受けられ、ここにあるのは市区町村が行った検診の国保の被保険者分だけ
- 縮小推定は「似た町の水準」へ寄せる。本当に飛び抜けた町があっても、対象者が少ないと控えめに出る
- 受診者0の町などは、報告の仕方の違いの可能性がある
code:
"""データの取得。
1) 地域保健・健康増進事業報告 健康増進編 市区町村表 第20-1表
   「健康診査、肺がん検診及び大腸がん検診対象者数・受診者数・受診率・（再掲）国民健康保険の被保険者，市区町村」
   e-Stat のファイル（CSV）。statInfId は次のとおり。
     令和3年度 000040038221 / 令和4年度 000040165455 / 令和5年度 000040262026 / 令和6年度 000040423652
   URL: https://www.e-stat.go.jp/stat-search/file-download?statInfId=<id>&fileKind=1 （Shift_JIS）
   ※ 実行環境から e-Stat に届かない場合は、ブラウザで取得したものを
     data/raw/f19_cancer_screening_raw.json（{"R3": csvテキスト, ...}）として置く（今回はこちら）。
2) SSDSE-A-2026（統計センター、共変量）… data/raw/SSDSE-A-2026.csv
3) 市区町村の境界（smartnews-smri/japan-topography、国土数値情報 行政区域 2021 の簡略版、CC BY 4.0）
"""
import json, urllib.request
from common import RAW

IDS = {"R3": "000040038221", "R4": "000040165455", "R5": "000040262026", "R6": "000040423652"}
dst = RAW / "f19_cancer_screening_raw.json"
if not dst.exists():
    out = {}
    for y, i in IDS.items():
        b = urllib.request.urlopen(f"https://www.e-stat.go.jp/stat-search/file-download?statInfId={i}&fileKind=1").read()
        out[y] = b.decode("cp932")
    json.dump(out, open(dst, "w"), ensure_ascii=False)
topo = RAW / "N03-21_210101.json"
if not topo.exists():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smartnews-smri/japan-topography/main/"
                               "data/municipality/topojson/s0010/N03-21_210101.json", topo)
print("ok", dst.exists(), topo.exists(), (RAW / "SSDSE-A-2026.csv").exists())

"""受診者数・対象者数（国保の被保険者、40〜69歳、大腸がん検診）と共変量の表を作る。"""
import io, csv, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from common import RAW, DATA

raw = json.load(open(RAW / "f19_cancer_screening_raw.json"))
YEAR = {"R3": 2021, "R4": 2022, "R5": 2023, "R6": 2024}
rows = []
for k, t in raw.items():
    for r in csv.reader(io.StringIO(t)):
        if not r or not r[0].strip().isdigit():
            continue
        code = int(r[0])
        if code == 0 or code % 1000 == 0:      # 全国・都道府県の行
            continue
        def num(x):
            x = x.strip()
            if x == "-":
                return 0.0
            try:
                return float(x)
            except ValueError:
                return np.nan                     # 「…」= 計数不詳
        rows.append(dict(code=code, name=r[1].strip(), year=YEAR[k],
                         n_colon=num(r[12]), y_colon=num(r[14]),
                         n_lung=num(r[11]), y_lung=num(r[13])))
d = pd.DataFrame(rows)
d["pref"] = d.code // 1000
print("行数", d.groupby("year").size().to_dict())

s = pd.read_csv(RAW / "SSDSE-A-2026.csv", encoding="cp932", skiprows=[0, 1])
s["code"] = s["地域コード"].str[1:].astype(int)
x = pd.DataFrame({
    "code": s.code,
    "pop": s["総人口"],
    "aged": s["65歳以上人口"] / s["総人口"],
    "logdens": np.log(s["総人口"] / s["可住地面積"].replace(0, np.nan)),
    "clinic": s["一般診療所数"] / s["総人口"] * 1e4,
    "hosp": s["一般病院数"] / s["総人口"] * 1e4,
    "primary": s["第1次産業就業者数"] / s["就業者数"],
    "single": s["単独世帯数"] / s["一般世帯数"],
})
d = d.merge(x, on="code", how="left")
print("共変量なし", d[d["pop"].isna()].code.unique()[:10], d["pop"].isna().sum())
d.to_csv(DATA / "screening_long.csv", index=False)
print("ok")

"""大腸がん検診（国保の被保険者、40〜69歳）の受診率を Fay–Herriot モデルで縮小推定する。
主な年は2023年度。2024年度の直接推定値を「答え」として、どちらの推定値が翌年をよく当てるかを確かめる。
"""
import json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from common import DATA, RES
from fh import fit

d = pd.read_csv(DATA / "screening_long.csv")
d = d[(d.n_colon > 0) & d.y_colon.notna() & d["pop"].notna() & (d["pop"] > 0)].copy()
d["p"] = d.y_colon / d.n_colon
d["z"] = np.arcsin(np.sqrt(d.p))           # 角変換：分散 ≒ 1/(4n) で p によらない
d["Dz"] = 1 / (4 * d.n_colon)
COV = ["aged", "logdens", "clinic", "hosp", "primary", "single"]
for c in COV:
    m, s = d[c].mean(), d[c].std()
    d[c + "_s"] = (d[c] - m) / s
back = lambda z: np.sin(np.clip(z, 0, np.pi / 2)) ** 2


def design(g, kind):
    X = [np.ones(len(g))]
    if kind in ("cov", "cov_pref"):
        X += [g[c + "_s"].values for c in COV]
    if kind in ("pref", "cov_pref"):
        P = pd.get_dummies(g.pref, drop_first=True).astype(float).values
        X += list(P.T)
    return np.column_stack(X)


def run(year, kind="cov_pref", phi=1.0, data=None):
    g = (d if data is None else data)
    g = g[g.year == year].copy()
    r = fit(g.z.values, design(g, kind), phi * g.Dz.values)
    g["eb_z"] = r["eb"]; g["gamma"] = r["gamma"]; g["synth_z"] = r["synth"]
    g["eb"] = back(g.eb_z); g["synth"] = back(g.synth_z)
    g["se_eb"] = np.sqrt(r["mse"]) * np.abs(np.sin(2 * g.eb_z))   # デルタ法で率の尺度へ
    g["se_dir"] = np.sqrt(g.p * (1 - g.p) / g.n_colon)
    return g, r


def validate(g, nxt):
    m = g.merge(nxt[["code", "p"]].rename(columns={"p": "p_next"}), on="code")
    out = {}
    for lab, cond in SIZE.items():
        mm = m[cond(m.n_colon)]
        out[lab] = dict(n=len(mm),
                        mse_dir=float(np.mean((mm.p - mm.p_next) ** 2)),
                        mse_eb=float(np.mean((mm.eb - mm.p_next) ** 2)))
    return out


SIZE = {"全体": lambda n: n > 0, "500人未満": lambda n: n < 500, "500〜2,000人": lambda n: (n >= 500) & (n < 2000),
        "2,000〜1万人": lambda n: (n >= 2000) & (n < 10000), "1万人以上": lambda n: n >= 10000}

summary = {}
# --- 年をまたぐぶれから、二項分布以上のぶれ（過分散）の大きさを見積もる
w = d.pivot_table(index="code", columns="year", values="z")
wn = d.pivot_table(index="code", columns="year", values="n_colon")
ratios = []
for a, b in [(2021, 2022), (2022, 2023), (2023, 2024)]:
    diff2 = (w[b] - w[a]) ** 2
    exp2 = 1 / (4 * wn[a]) + 1 / (4 * wn[b])
    ok = diff2.notna() & exp2.notna()
    big = wn[a] >= 0
    ratios.append(float(np.median(diff2[ok] / exp2[ok]) / 0.4549))   # χ²(1) の中央値で割る
summary["overdispersion_phi_yearpairs"] = ratios
phi_hat = float(np.median(ratios))
summary["phi_hat"] = phi_hat

# --- 基本の推定（2023年度、共変量＋都道府県ダミー、二項分布どおりの分散）
g23, r23 = run(2023)
g24, _ = run(2024)
summary["base"] = dict(n=len(g23), A_z=r23["A"], sd_between_pt=float(np.sqrt(r23["A"]) * 100 * 2 * np.sqrt(0.2 * 0.8)),
                       gamma_median=float(np.median(r23["gamma"])),
                       gamma_by_size={k: float(g23.loc[f(g23.n_colon), "gamma"].median()) for k, f in SIZE.items()},
                       beta=dict(zip(["const"] + COV, map(float, r23["beta"][:7]))),
                       validation_2024=validate(g23, g24))
g23.to_csv(RES / "estimates_2023.csv", index=False,
           columns=["code", "name", "pref", "n_colon", "y_colon", "p", "se_dir", "eb", "se_eb", "synth", "gamma"])

# --- 過分散を入れた版（年ごとのぶれの実測から D を φ 倍）
g23o, r23o = run(2023, phi=phi_hat)
summary["overdisp"] = dict(phi=phi_hat, gamma_by_size={k: float(g23o.loc[f(g23o.n_colon), "gamma"].median()) for k, f in SIZE.items()},
                           validation_2024=validate(g23o, g24))
g23o[["code", "eb", "gamma"]].rename(columns={"eb": "eb_od", "gamma": "gamma_od"}).to_csv(RES / "estimates_2023_overdisp.csv", index=False)

# --- ランキング：上位・下位50の中の小さな町
def rank_share(g, col, k=50):
    s = g.sort_values(col)
    lo, hi = s.head(k), s.tail(k)
    small = lambda x: int((x.n_colon < 500).sum())
    return dict(bottom_small=small(lo), top_small=small(hi), bottom_med_n=float(lo.n_colon.median()), top_med_n=float(hi.n_colon.median()))
summary["ranking"] = {"直接推定": rank_share(g23, "p"), "縮小推定": rank_share(g23, "eb"), "縮小推定（過分散あり）": rank_share(g23.assign(eb=g23o.eb.values), "eb"),
                      "全体での500人未満の割合": float((g23.n_colon < 500).mean())}
s_dir = g23.p.rank(ascending=False); s_eb = g23.eb.rank(ascending=False)
summary["ranking"]["top50_overlap"] = int(len(set(g23.code[s_dir <= 50]) & set(g23.code[s_eb <= 50])))
summary["ranking"]["bottom50_overlap"] = int(len(set(g23.code[s_dir > len(g23) - 50]) & set(g23.code[s_eb > len(g23) - 50])))

# --- 頑健性
rob = []
for lab, kw in [("基本（共変量＋都道府県）", {}), ("共変量なし（全国平均へ寄せる）", dict(kind="none")),
                ("都道府県ダミーだけ", dict(kind="pref")), ("共変量だけ", dict(kind="cov")),
                ("過分散あり（D×φ）", dict(phi=phi_hat))]:
    a, _ = run(2023, **kw); b, _ = run(2024, **kw)
    v = validate(a, b)
    rob.append(dict(設定=lab, 全体_直接=v["全体"]["mse_dir"], 全体_縮小=v["全体"]["mse_eb"],
                    小_直接=v["500人未満"]["mse_dir"], 小_縮小=v["500人未満"]["mse_eb"]))
# 2022→2023 でも同じ確かめ
a, _ = run(2022); b, _ = run(2023); v = validate(a, b)
rob.append(dict(設定="基本、2022→2023で検証", 全体_直接=v["全体"]["mse_dir"], 全体_縮小=v["全体"]["mse_eb"],
                小_直接=v["500人未満"]["mse_dir"], 小_縮小=v["500人未満"]["mse_eb"]))
# 受診者0の町を除く
dd = d[d.y_colon > 0]
a, _ = run(2023, data=dd); b, _ = run(2024, data=dd); v = validate(a, b)
rob.append(dict(設定="受診者0の町を除く", 全体_直接=v["全体"]["mse_dir"], 全体_縮小=v["全体"]["mse_eb"],
                小_直接=v["500人未満"]["mse_dir"], 小_縮小=v["500人未満"]["mse_eb"]))
# 都道府県ごとに別々に推定（町が20以上の県）
parts = []
for p_, gp in d[d.year == 2023].groupby("pref"):
    if len(gp) < 20:
        continue
    r = fit(gp.z.values, np.column_stack([np.ones(len(gp))] + [gp[c + "_s"].values for c in COV]), gp.Dz.values)
    parts.append(gp.assign(eb=back(r["eb"])))
gp23 = pd.concat(parts)
cmp_ = gp23.merge(g23[["code", "eb"]].rename(columns={"eb": "eb_nat"}), on="code")
summary["pref_separate"] = dict(n_pref=len(parts), n=len(cmp_), corr_with_national=float(np.corrcoef(cmp_.eb, cmp_.eb_nat)[0, 1]),
                                max_abs_diff_pt=float((cmp_.eb - cmp_.eb_nat).abs().max() * 100))
v = validate(gp23, g24)
rob.append(dict(設定="都道府県ごとに別々に推定", 全体_直接=v["全体"]["mse_dir"], 全体_縮小=v["全体"]["mse_eb"],
                小_直接=v["500人未満"]["mse_dir"], 小_縮小=v["500人未満"]["mse_eb"]))
rob = pd.DataFrame(rob)
for c in ["全体", "小"]:
    rob[c + "_改善%"] = (1 - rob[c + "_縮小"] / rob[c + "_直接"]) * 100
rob.to_csv(RES / "robustness.csv", index=False)
summary["robustness"] = rob.round(6).to_dict(orient="records")
json.dump(summary, open(RES / "summary.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
print(json.dumps({k: summary[k] for k in ["phi_hat", "base", "overdisp", "ranking", "pref_separate"]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
print(rob.round(5).to_string())

from common import RAW, RES, FIG

"""Fay–Herriot モデル（REML）の最小限の実装。
  θ̂_i = x_i'β + u_i + e_i,  u_i ~ N(0, A),  e_i ~ N(0, D_i)（D_i は既知）
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar


def _parts(A, y, X, D):
    V = A + D
    W = 1.0 / V
    XtWX = X.T @ (X * W[:, None])
    beta = np.linalg.solve(XtWX, X.T @ (W * y))
    r = y - X @ beta
    return V, W, XtWX, beta, r


def reml_negll(logA, y, X, D):
    A = np.exp(logA)
    V, W, XtWX, beta, r = _parts(A, y, X, D)
    sign, logdet = np.linalg.slogdet(XtWX)
    return 0.5 * (np.sum(np.log(V)) + logdet + np.sum(W * r * r))


def fit(y, X, D):
    y, X, D = np.asarray(y, float), np.asarray(X, float), np.asarray(D, float)
    res = minimize_scalar(reml_negll, bounds=(np.log(1e-8), np.log(10 * np.var(y) + 1e-8)),
                          args=(y, X, D), method="bounded")
    A = float(np.exp(res.x))
    V, W, XtWX, beta, r = _parts(A, y, X, D)
    gamma = A / (A + D)
    synth = X @ beta
    eb = gamma * y + (1 - gamma) * synth
    # Prasad–Rao 型の MSE の近似（g1 + g2。g3 は省略）
    g1 = gamma * D
    inv = np.linalg.inv(XtWX)
    g2 = (1 - gamma) ** 2 * np.einsum("ij,jk,ik->i", X, inv, X)
    return dict(A=A, beta=beta, gamma=gamma, synth=synth, eb=eb, mse=g1 + g2)

title: F20 出生率は隣の町と似るのか？ 空間回帰で考える
data_sec:
- 出生率：厚生労働省「人口動態保健所・市区町村別統計」の合計特殊出生率（ベイズ推定値、2018〜22年。頑健性で2013〜17年）
- 説明する変数（社会・人口統計体系、2020年。住宅は2018年の住宅・土地統計調査）
  - 15〜39歳女性の割合（15歳以上女性 − 40歳以上女性）÷ 総人口
  - 納税者1人あたり課税対象所得（対数）。政令市の区は区の値がないので市の値（129区域）
  - 市区町村外への通勤・通学の割合（流出人口 ÷ 従業・通学者）
  - 0〜5歳人口千人あたり保育所等数
  - 第3次産業就業者の割合
  - 可住地1km²あたり人口（対数）
- 境界と隣接：国土数値情報 行政区域 2021 の簡略版 TopoJSON。境界線（弧）を共有する区域を「隣」とする（Queen 隣接）。島などで隣がない50区域は、いちばん近い1区域を隣とした
- 分析対象：1,841区域（出生率が「…」の福島・熊本の9町村、人口0の区域、データが欠けた区域を除く）

- すべて相関で、どの施策が出生を増やすかは言えない。保育所数の負の係数は、子どもが少ない町ほど「子ども千人あたり」の数が大きくなる逆向きの関係を含む
- 出生率はベイズ推定値で、小さな町の値は県や二次医療圏の値に寄せられている。隣どうしが似る理由の一部は、この推定方法そのものにある

"""02 整形：出生率（ベイズ推定値）と地域の特徴を、市区町村（政令市は区）単位の1つの表にする。
単位は 国土数値情報 行政区域 2021（簡略版 TopoJSON）の1,902区域。"""
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from common import RAW, DATA

d = json.load(open(RAW / "f20_raw.json", encoding="utf-8"))


def table(rows):
    h = rows[0]
    out = []
    for r in rows[1:]:
        code, name = r[0].split("_", 1)
        rec = {"code": code, "name": name}
        for c, v in zip(h[1:], r[1:]):
            v = v.replace(",", "")
            try:
                rec[c] = float(v)
            except ValueError:
                rec[c] = np.nan
        out.append(rec)
    return pd.DataFrame(out).set_index("code")


def tfr(rows):
    s = {}
    for code, name, bayes, raw in rows:
        s[code] = bayes if isinstance(bayes, (int, float)) else np.nan
    return pd.Series(s)


topo = json.load(open(RAW / "N03-21_210101.json", encoding="utf-8"))
geoms = list(topo["objects"].values())[0]["geometries"]
units = sorted({g["properties"]["N03_007"] for g in geoms if g["properties"].get("N03_007")})


def city_of(code):
    # 政令市の区（例 01101）→ 市（01100）。東京23区（131xx）はそのまま
    if code[:2] != "13" and code[2] == "1" and code[4] != "0":
        return code[:4] + "0"
    return code


def build(year_p, year_h, tfr_key):
    P = table(d[f"P{year_p}"])
    H = table(d[f"H{year_h}"])
    y = tfr(d[tfr_key])
    rows = []
    for u in units:
        rec = {"code": u}
        p = P.loc[u] if u in P.index else None
        if p is None:
            continue
        rec["name"] = p["name"]
        rec["pref"] = u[:2]
        rec["tfr"] = y.get(u, np.nan)
        pop = p["A1101"]
        rec["pop"] = pop
        rec["young_f"] = (p["A141402"] - p["A141502"]) / pop * 100
        # 所得：区の値がなければ市の値で補う
        inc, tax = p["C120110"], p["C120120"]
        if (np.isnan(inc) or np.isnan(tax)) and city_of(u) in P.index:
            inc, tax = P.loc[city_of(u), "C120110"], P.loc[city_of(u), "C120120"]
            rec["income_from_city"] = 1
        rec["income"] = np.log(inc / tax) if tax and tax > 0 else np.nan  # 納税者1人あたり課税対象所得（千円）の対数
        den = p["A6102"] + p["A6103"] + p["A6104"]
        rec["commute_out"] = (p["A6103"] + p["A6104"]) / den * 100 if den > 0 else np.nan
        nur = p.get("J250302", np.nan) if "J250302" in p.index else p.get("J2503", np.nan)
        rec["nursery"] = nur / p["A1405"] * 1000 if p["A1405"] > 0 else np.nan
        rec["tertiary"] = p["F2221"] / p["F1102"] * 100 if p["F1102"] > 0 else np.nan
        rec["density"] = np.log(pop / (p["B1103"] / 100)) if p["B1103"] > 0 else np.nan  # 可住地 1km2 あたり人口の対数
        rec["unmarried"] = p["A161001"]
        rec["aged"] = p["A1303"] / pop * 100
        if u in H.index:
            h = H.loc[u]
            rec["owner"] = h["H1310"] / h["H1101"] * 100 if h["H1101"] > 0 else np.nan
            rec["floor"] = h["H2130"]
        rows.append(rec)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("code")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    a = build(2020, 2018, "tfr_2018_22")
    b = build(2015, 2013, "tfr_2013_17")
    a.to_csv(DATA / "municipal_2018_22.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    b.to_csv(DATA / "municipal_2013_17.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    for n, x in (("2018-22", a), ("2013-17", b)):

"""03 分析：OLS → 残差の Moran's I → LM 検定 → 空間ラグ（SAR）・空間誤差（SEM）→ 直接・間接効果 → GWR → 頑健性"""
import json
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import libpysal
from libpysal.weights import W, KNN, DistanceBand
from esda.moran import Moran
import spreg
from mgwr.gwr import GWR
from mgwr.sel_bw import Sel_BW
from common import DATA, RES, SEED, load_topo, to_km

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(SEED)

X_MAIN = ["young_f", "income", "commute_out", "nursery", "tertiary", "density"]
LABEL = {"young_f": "15〜39歳女性の割合", "income": "納税者1人あたり所得（対数）", "commute_out": "市区町村外への通勤・通学の割合",
         "nursery": "0〜5歳千人あたり保育所数", "tertiary": "第3次産業就業者の割合", "density": "可住地の人口密度（対数）",
         "unmarried": "未婚者の割合", "owner": "持ち家の割合", "floor": "1住宅あたり延べ面積"}

rings, used = load_topo()
cent = {c: np.vstack(r).mean(axis=0) for c, r in rings.items()}


def sample(period, xs, drop_big=False):
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA / f"municipal_{period}.csv", dtype={"code": str, "pref": str}).set_index("code")
    df = df[(df["pop"] > 0)].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=["tfr"] + xs)
    df = df[df.index.isin(rings.keys())]
    if drop_big:
        ix = pd.Series(df.index, index=df.index)
        big = ix.str[2].eq("1") | ix.str.startswith("131")
        df = df[~big]
    return df


def queen(codes):
    codes = list(codes)
    owner = {}
    for c in codes:
        for a in used[c]:
            owner.setdefault(a, set()).add(c)
    nb = {c: set() for c in codes}
    for s in owner.values():
        for c in s:
            nb[c] |= s - {c}
    xy = np.array([cent[c] for c in codes])
    kx, ky = to_km(xy[:, 0], xy[:, 1])
    P = np.c_[kx, ky]
    n_island = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(codes):
        if not nb[c]:  # 島などで接する区域がない → いちばん近い1区域を隣とする
            dd = np.hypot(*(P - P[i]).T)
            dd[i] = np.inf
            nb[c] = {codes[int(np.argmin(dd))]}
            n_island += 1
    for c in codes:  # 対称にする
        for o in list(nb[c]):
            nb[o].add(c)
    w = W({c: sorted(nb[c]) for c in codes}, id_order=codes, silence_warnings=True)
    w.transform = "r"
    return w, P, n_island


def weights(codes, kind):
    w, P, n_island = queen(codes)
    if kind == "queen":
        return w, P, n_island
    if kind == "knn6":
        w2 = KNN(P, k=6, ids=list(codes))
    elif kind == "dist30":
        w2 = DistanceBand(P, threshold=30, binary=False, alpha=-1.0, ids=list(codes), silence_warnings=True)
        # 30km 以内に誰もいない区域は Queen の隣で補う
        neigh = {c: list(w2.neighbors[c]) or list(w.neighbors[c]) for c in codes}
        wts = {c: list(w2.weights[c]) if w2.neighbors[c] else [1.0] * len(w.neighbors[c]) for c in codes}
        w2 = W(neigh, wts, id_order=list(codes), silence_warnings=True)
    w2.transform = "r"
    return w2, P, n_island


def zscore(df, xs):
    Z = df[xs].copy()
    return (Z - Z.mean()) / Z.std(ddof=0)


def impacts(rho, beta, w):
    n = w.n
    Wd = w.full()[0]
    S = np.linalg.inv(np.eye(n) - rho * Wd)
    d_mult = np.trace(S) / n
    t_mult = 1 / (1 - rho)
    return {"direct": beta * d_mult, "indirect": beta * (t_mult - d_mult), "total": beta * t_mult}


def fit(period="2018_22", xs=X_MAIN, wkind="queen", drop_big=False, do_gwr=False, tag="main"):
    df = sample(period, xs, drop_big)
    codes = list(df.index)
    w, P, n_island = weights(codes, wkind)
    y = df[["tfr"]].values
    Z = zscore(df, xs)
    X = Z.values
    out = {"tag": tag, "period": period, "weights": wkind, "n": len(df), "islands_linked": n_island, "x": xs}
    mi_y = Moran(df["tfr"].values, w, permutations=999)
    out["moran_y"] = [float(mi_y.I), float(mi_y.p_sim)]
    ols = spreg.OLS(y, X, w=w, spat_diag=True, moran=True, name_y="tfr", name_x=xs)
    res = ols.u.flatten()
    mi_r = Moran(res, w, permutations=999)
    out["ols"] = {"beta": ols.betas.flatten().tolist(), "se": np.sqrt(np.diag(ols.vm)).tolist(), "r2": float(ols.r2), "aic": float(ols.aic)}
    out["moran_resid"] = [float(mi_r.I), float(mi_r.p_sim)]
    out["lm"] = {"lm_lag": list(map(float, ols.lm_lag)), "lm_error": list(map(float, ols.lm_error)),
                 "rlm_lag": list(map(float, ols.rlm_lag)), "rlm_error": list(map(float, ols.rlm_error))}
    lag = spreg.ML_Lag(y, X, w=w, name_y="tfr", name_x=xs)
    err = spreg.ML_Error(y, X, w=w, name_y="tfr", name_x=xs)
    out["sar"] = {"beta": lag.betas.flatten().tolist(), "se": np.sqrt(np.diag(lag.vm)).tolist(), "rho": float(lag.rho), "aic": float(lag.aic), "logll": float(lag.logll)}
    out["sem"] = {"beta": err.betas.flatten().tolist(), "se": np.sqrt(np.diag(err.vm)).tolist(), "lambda": float(err.lam), "aic": float(err.aic), "logll": float(err.logll)}
    out["moran_resid_sar"] = float(Moran(lag.u.flatten(), w, permutations=0).I)
    out["moran_resid_sem"] = float(Moran(err.e_filtered.flatten(), w, permutations=0).I)
    if wkind == "queen" and len(df) < 2500:
        b = np.array(lag.betas.flatten()[1:len(xs) + 1])
        im = impacts(lag.rho, b, w)
        out["impacts"] = {k: v.tolist() for k, v in im.items()}
        # 影響の不確かさ：係数と rho を推定の共分散から500回引いて分布を見る
        rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
        vm = lag.vm
        k = len(xs) + 1
        idx = list(range(1, k)) + [k]
        draws = rng.multivariate_normal(np.r_[lag.betas.flatten()[1:k], lag.rho], vm[np.ix_(idx, idx)], size=500)
        Wd = w.full()[0]
        ev = np.linalg.eigvals(Wd).real
        sims = []
        for dr in draws:
            r_ = dr[-1]
            dm = np.mean(1 / (1 - r_ * ev))
            tm = 1 / (1 - r_)
            sims.append(np.r_[dr[:-1] * dm, dr[:-1] * (tm - dm)])
        sims = np.array(sims)
        out["impacts_ci"] = {"direct": np.percentile(sims[:, :len(xs)], [2.5, 97.5], axis=0).tolist(),
                             "indirect": np.percentile(sims[:, len(xs):], [2.5, 97.5], axis=0).tolist()}
    if do_gwr:
        bw = Sel_BW(P, y, X, kernel="bisquare", fixed=False).search(criterion="AICc")
        g = GWR(P, y, X, bw, kernel="bisquare", fixed=False).fit()
        tv = g.filter_tvals()
        loc = pd.DataFrame(g.params, index=codes, columns=["const"] + xs)
        loc_t = pd.DataFrame(tv, index=codes, columns=["const"] + xs)
        loc.join(loc_t, rsuffix="_t_filtered").to_csv(RES / f"gwr_local_{tag}.csv", encoding="utf-8")
        sig = (loc_t != 0)
        out["gwr"] = {"bw": int(bw), "aicc": float(g.aicc), "r2": float(g.R2), "ols_aicc": float(spreg.OLS(y, X).aic),
                      "pos_share": {c: float((loc[c] > 0).mean()) for c in xs},
                      "sig_pos_share": {c: float(((loc_t[c] > 0)).mean()) for c in xs},
                      "sig_neg_share": {c: float(((loc_t[c] < 0)).mean()) for c in xs},
                      "q": {c: np.percentile(loc[c], [5, 25, 50, 75, 95]).round(4).tolist() for c in xs},
                      "moran_resid": float(Moran(g.resid_response.flatten(), w, permutations=0).I)}
        # Monte Carlo 的な目安：係数のばらつき（四分位範囲）を GWR の標準誤差の中央値と比べる
        out["gwr"]["iqr_over_se"] = {c: float((np.percentile(loc[c], 75) - np.percentile(loc[c], 25)) / np.median(g.bse[:, i + 1])) for i, c in enumerate(xs)}
    df.assign(ols_resid=res).to_csv(RES / f"data_{tag}.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    allres = {}
    allres["main"] = fit(do_gwr=True)
    print("main done", allres["main"]["n"])
    runs = [
        dict(wkind="knn6", tag="knn6"),
        dict(wkind="dist30", tag="dist30"),
        dict(period="2013_17", tag="p2013_17"),
        dict(drop_big=True, tag="no_big_city"),
        dict(xs=X_MAIN + ["unmarried"], tag="with_unmarried"),

def load_topo():
    """簡略版 TopoJSON（国土数値情報 行政区域 2021）を読み、区域コード → 輪郭（リングのリスト）と、
    区域コード → 使っている弧の番号 の2つを返す。"""
    import json
    import numpy as np
    topo = json.load(open(RAW / "N03-21_210101.json", encoding="utf-8"))
    geoms = list(topo["objects"].values())[0]["geometries"]
    sc, tr = topo["transform"]["scale"], topo["transform"]["translate"]
    arcs = []
    for arc in topo["arcs"]:
        a = np.cumsum(np.array(arc, dtype=float), axis=0)
        arcs.append(np.c_[a[:, 0] * sc[0] + tr[0], a[:, 1] * sc[1] + tr[1]])

    def ring(idx):
        pts = []
        for i in idx:
            seg = arcs[i] if i >= 0 else arcs[~i][::-1]
            pts.append(seg if not pts else seg[1:])
        return np.vstack(pts)

    rings, used = {}, {}
    for g in geoms:
        code = g["properties"].get("N03_007")
        if not code:
            continue
        polys = g["arcs"] if g["type"] == "MultiPolygon" else [g["arcs"]] if g["type"] == "Polygon" else []
        for poly in polys:
            for r in poly:
                rings.setdefault(code, []).append(ring(r))
                used.setdefault(code, set()).update(i if i >= 0 else ~i for i in r)
    return rings, used


def to_km(lon, lat):
    import numpy as np
    return (np.asarray(lon) - 137.0) * 111.32 * np.cos(np.radians(36.0)), (np.asarray(lat) - 36.0) * 110.57

def main():
    cols, meta = {}, []
    # 消費者物価指数（2020年基準、原数値）
    c = pd.read_csv(RAW / "cpi_chuubunrui.csv", header=None, dtype=str)
    head = c.iloc[0].tolist()
    body = c[c[0].str.fullmatch(r"\d{6}", na=False)]
    idx = pd.to_datetime(body[0], format="%Y%m")
    for name in CPI:
        j = head.index(name)
        s = pd.Series(pd.to_numeric(body[j], errors="coerce").values, index=idx)

if __name__ == "__main__":

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RES = ROOT / "results"
THR = 4.0

# 出来事の年表（答え合わせ用）。expect は「この出来事なら動くはずの系列」
EVENTS = [
    ("2008-10", "2009-03", "リーマン・ショック後の生産の急減", "景気", ["景気:鉱工業生産", "景気:生産財出荷", "景気:投資財出荷", "景気:輸出数量", "景気:耐久消費財出荷"]),
    ("2010-04", "2010-04", "高校授業料の実質無償化", "制度", ["物価:授業料等"]),
    ("2010-09", "2010-10", "たばこ税の大幅な引き上げ（駆け込みと値上げ）", "制度", ["物価:たばこ", "家計:たばこ"]),
    ("2011-03", "2011-04", "東日本大震災", "災害", ["景気:鉱工業生産", "景気:生産財出荷", "景気:耐久消費財出荷", "景気:消費者態度指数", "景気:輸出数量"]),
    ("2014-03", "2014-04", "消費税8%（駆け込みと反動）", "制度", ["家計:家事用耐久財", "家計:冷暖房用器具", "家計:教養娯楽用耐久財", "家計:自動車等購入", "景気:耐久消費財出荷", "景気:小売販売額（前年比）"]),
    ("2018-01", "2018-01", "家計調査の家計簿の改正", "統計の変更", [k for k in []]),
    ("2019-09", "2019-10", "消費税10%・幼児教育の無償化", "制度", ["家計:家事用耐久財", "家計:冷暖房用器具", "家計:教養娯楽用耐久財", "景気:耐久消費財出荷", "景気:小売販売額（前年比）", "物価:補習教育", "物価:授業料等"]),
    ("2020-03", "2020-06", "新型コロナの感染拡大と緊急事態宣言", "感染症", ["家計:一般外食", "家計:宿泊料", "家計:パック旅行費", "景気:鉱工業生産", "景気:輸出数量", "景気:消費者態度指数", "景気:新規求人数", "景気:労働投入量"]),
    ("2020-04", "2020-04", "高等教育の修学支援（授業料減免）", "制度", ["物価:授業料等"]),
    ("2020-08", "2021-01", "Go To トラベル（割引の開始と停止）", "制度", ["物価:教養娯楽サービス", "家計:宿泊料", "家計:パック旅行費"]),
    ("2021-04", "2021-04", "携帯電話の通信料の値下げ", "制度", ["物価:通信"]),
    ("2022-10", "2022-10", "全国旅行支援の開始", "制度", ["物価:教養娯楽サービス"]),
    ("2023-02", "2023-02", "電気・ガス代の負担軽減策の開始", "制度", ["物価:電気代", "物価:ガス代"]),
    ("2024-05", "2024-06", "電気・ガス代の負担軽減策の縮小・終了", "制度", ["物価:電気代", "物価:ガス代"]),
]
# 2018-01 の家計簿の改正は、家計調査のすべての系列が対象
EVENTS[5] = (*EVENTS[5][:4], None)


def months(a, b, pad=1):
    s, e = pd.Timestamp(a) - pd.DateOffset(months=pad), pd.Timestamp(b) + pd.DateOffset(months=pad)
    return pd.date_range(s, e, freq="MS")


def build_z(ch, seasonal=13, robust=True):
    return pd.DataFrame({c: stl_robust_z(ch[c], seasonal=seasonal, robust=robust) for c in ch.columns})


def evaluate(F, pad=1):
    """F: 月×系列の True/False。出来事ごとに「期待した系列のどれかに印が付いたか」（再現率）と、印のうち出来事の窓に入る割合。"""
    rows, in_any = [], pd.DataFrame(False, index=F.index, columns=F.columns)
    for a, b, lab, cat, exp in EVENTS:
        win = months(a, b, pad).intersection(F.index)
        cols = [c for c in F.columns if c.startswith("家計:")] if exp is None else [c for c in exp if c in F.columns]
        hit = F.loc[win, cols]
        found = hit.any().any()
        rows.append(dict(start=a, end=b, event=lab, category=cat, detected=bool(found),
                         n_series_flagged=int(hit.any().sum()), n_expected=len(cols),
                         flagged=";".join(sorted(hit.columns[hit.any()].str.split(":").str[1]))))
        in_any.loc[win, cols] = True
    ev = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    nflag = int(F.values.sum())
    explained = int((F & in_any).values.sum())
    # 「何かの出来事の窓（どの系列でもよい）」に入る印
    allwin = pd.DatetimeIndex(sorted(set().union(*[months(a, b, pad) for a, b, *_ in EVENTS]))).intersection(F.index)
    in_window_any = int(F.loc[allwin].values.sum())
    return ev, dict(recall=ev.detected.mean(), n_flags=nflag, explained_by_expected=explained,
                    share_explained=explained / max(nflag, 1), share_in_event_months=in_window_any / max(nflag, 1),
                    event_months_share=len(allwin) / len(F.index))


def main():
    ch = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data" / "changes.csv", parse_dates=["month"], index_col="month")
    Z = build_z(ch)
    Z.to_csv(RES / "z_scores.csv", float_format="%.3f")
    F = flag(Z, THR)
    ev, summ = evaluate(F)
    ev.to_csv(RES / "events_check.csv", index=False)

    # 印の一覧（大きい順）
    st = Z.stack().rename("z").reset_index().rename(columns={"level_1": "series"})
    st = st[st.z.abs() > THR].assign(absz=lambda d: d.z.abs()).sort_values("absz", ascending=False)
    st.to_csv(RES / "flags_stl_thr4.csv", index=False, float_format="%.2f")

    # 月ごと：印の付いた系列の数と、Isolation Forest のスコア
    breadth = F.sum(axis=1)
    iso = isolation_scores(Z, seed=0)
    iso_seeds = pd.concat([isolation_scores(Z, seed=s) for s in range(5)], axis=1)
    monthly = pd.DataFrame({"n_flagged": breadth, "iso_score": iso, "iso_rank": iso.rank(ascending=False).astype(int)})
    ev_months = set().union(*[months(a, b, 1) for a, b, *_ in EVENTS])
    monthly["in_event_window"] = monthly.index.isin(list(ev_months))
    monthly.to_csv(RES / "monthly_scores.csv", float_format="%.4f")
    top = monthly.sort_values("iso_score", ascending=False).head(15).copy()
    # 上位の月で、z が大きかった系列（上位3つ）
    top["top_series"] = [";".join(f"{c.split(':')[1]}({Z.loc[m, c]:+.1f})" for c in Z.loc[m].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index[:3]) for m in top.index]
    top.to_csv(RES / "top_months_isolation.csv", float_format="%.4f")
    seed_rank_corr = iso_seeds.corr(method="spearman").values[np.triu_indices(5, 1)]

    def topk_precision(score, k):
        t = score.sort_values(ascending=False).head(k).index
        return float(np.mean([m in ev_months for m in t]))

    # 変化点（季節を除いた水準）
    lv = {}
    raw_cpi = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data" / "raw" / "cpi_chuubunrui.csv", header=None, dtype=str)
    head = raw_cpi.iloc[0].tolist(); body = raw_cpi[raw_cpi[0].str.fullmatch(r"\d{6}", na=False)]
    idx = pd.to_datetime(body[0], format="%Y%m")
    for name in ["通信", "授業料等", "電気代", "たばこ"]:
        lv[f"物価:{name}"] = np.log(pd.Series(pd.to_numeric(body[head.index(name)]).values, index=idx)).loc["2005":"2026-08"] * 100
    ci = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data" / "raw" / "ci_monthly_levels.csv", parse_dates=["month"], index_col="month")
    lv["景気:完全失業率"] = ci["完全失業率"].loc["2005":"2026-08"]
    cps = {}
    for k, s in lv.items():
        # 物価の制度系列は季節性がほぼないので季節調整なし。失業率は季節調整済みの値だが念のため STL を通す
        bk, sa = change_points(s, deseason=k.startswith("景気"), pen_mult=4.0 if k.startswith("物価") else 20.0)
        cps[k] = [d.strftime("%Y-%m") for d in bk]
        sa.rename(k).to_frame().to_csv(RES / f"level_sa_{k.split(':')[1]}.csv", float_format="%.4f")
    json.dump(cps, open(RES / "change_points.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)

    # 閾値と検出数・再現率（トレードオフ）
    trade = []
    for thr in [2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 5, 6, 8]:
        e2, s2 = evaluate(flag(Z, thr))
        trade.append(dict(thr=thr, n_flags=s2["n_flags"], flags_per_series_year=s2["n_flags"] / Z.shape[1] / (len(Z) / 12),
                          recall=s2["recall"], share_explained=s2["share_explained"], share_in_event_months=s2["share_in_event_months"]))
    trade = pd.DataFrame(trade); trade.to_csv(RES / "threshold_tradeoff.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")

    # 頑健性
    rob = []
    def add(name, Zx, F_=None):
        F_ = flag(Zx, THR) if F_ is None else F_
        e2, s2 = evaluate(F_)
        rob.append(dict(setting=name, n_flags=s2["n_flags"], recall=s2["recall"], share_explained=s2["share_explained"],
                        share_in_event_months=s2["share_in_event_months"],
                        iso_top15_in_event=topk_precision(isolation_scores(Zx), 15)))
    add("基本（STL seasonal=13・robust・閾値4）", Z)
    add("STL seasonal=7", build_z(ch, seasonal=7))
    add("STL seasonal=25", build_z(ch, seasonal=25))
    add("STL robust=False", build_z(ch, robust=False))
    zplain = ch.apply(lambda x: (x - x.median()) / (1.4826 * (x - x.median()).abs().median()))
    add("STL なし（変化をそのまま頑健z）", zplain)
    for src, lab in [("物価:", "物価だけ"), ("景気:", "景気動向指数の系列だけ"), ("家計:", "家計調査だけ")]:
        Zs = Z[[c for c in Z.columns if c.startswith(src)]]
        add(lab, Zs)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    for i in range(3):
        cols = rng.choice(Z.columns, size=len(Z.columns) // 2, replace=False)
        add(f"系列を半分だけ無作為に（{i+1}回目）", Z[cols])
    rob = pd.DataFrame(rob); rob.to_csv(RES / "robustness.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")

    # 偶然の基準：同じ数の印を月にランダムに置いたときの「出来事の窓に入る割合」
    p_base = len(set(ev_months).intersection(Z.index)) / len(Z.index)

    out = dict(n_series=Z.shape[1], n_months=Z.shape[0], period=f"{Z.index[0]:%Y-%m}〜{Z.index[-1]:%Y-%m}",
               thr=THR, **{k: (float(v) if isinstance(v, (np.floating, float)) else v) for k, v in summ.items()},
               random_baseline_share_in_event_months=p_base,
               iso_top15_in_event=topk_precision(iso, 15), iso_top30_in_event=topk_precision(iso, 30),
               breadth_top15_in_event=topk_precision(breadth + iso * 1e-6, 15),
               iso_seed_rank_corr_min=float(seed_rank_corr.min()),
               change_points=cps)
    json.dump(out, open(RES / "summary.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=float)
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in out.items() if k != "change_points"}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=float))
    print(ev[["start", "event", "detected", "n_series_flagged", "n_expected", "flagged"]].to_string())
    print(top[["n_flagged", "iso_score", "in_event_window", "top_series"]].to_string())
    print(trade.to_string()); print(rob.to_string()); print(cps)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""detect.py ― 月次の統計に「いつもと違う動き」の印を付ける関数（他の系列にもそのまま使える）

使い方の例:
    from detect import stl_robust_z, flag, isolation_scores, change_points
    z = stl_robust_z(series)            # pandas.Series（月次、DatetimeIndex）→ 残差の頑健な z スコア
    f = flag(z, thr=4.0)                # |z| が閾値を超えた月に True
"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import STL


def to_change(s: pd.Series, kind: str) -> pd.Series:
    """水準の系列を「前月からの変化」にする。kind='log' は対数差（%に近い）、'diff' はそのままの差。"""
    s = s.astype(float)
    if kind == "log":
        s = s.where(s > 0)
        return np.log(s).diff() * 100
    return s.diff()


def robust_z(x: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """中央値と MAD（中央絶対偏差）で標準化。外れ値に引っぱられにくい z スコア。"""
    med = np.nanmedian(x)
    dev = np.abs(x - med)
    mad = np.nanmedian(dev) * 1.4826
    # 値がほとんど動かない系列（物価の公共料金など）は MAD が 0 近くになり、z が爆発する。
    # 平均絶対偏差（×1.2533 で正規分布の標準偏差に合わせる）を下限にする。
    meanad = np.nanmean(dev) * 1.2533
    scale = max(mad, meanad)
    if not np.isfinite(scale) or scale == 0:
        scale = 1.0
    return (x - med) / scale


def stl_robust_z(change: pd.Series, period: int = 12, seasonal: int = 13, robust: bool = True) -> pd.Series:
    """前月からの変化を STL で「季節」「トレンド」「残差」に分け、残差を頑健な z スコアにする。"""
    c = change.dropna()
    if len(c) < 3 * period:
        return pd.Series(np.nan, index=change.index)
    res = STL(c, period=period, seasonal=seasonal, robust=robust).fit()
    z = robust_z(res.resid)
    return z.reindex(change.index)


def flag(z: pd.DataFrame | pd.Series, thr: float = 4.0):
    """|z| が閾値を超えたところに True。"""
    return z.abs() > thr


def isolation_scores(Z: pd.DataFrame, clip: float = 10.0, n_estimators: int = 500, seed: int = 0) -> pd.Series:
    """月×系列の z スコア行列から、Isolation Forest で「月ごとの異常の度合い」を出す（大きいほど異常）。"""
    from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
    X = Z.fillna(0).clip(-clip, clip).abs()
    m = IsolationForest(n_estimators=n_estimators, random_state=seed).fit(X)
    return pd.Series(-m.score_samples(X), index=Z.index)


def change_points(level: pd.Series, period: int = 12, pen: float | None = None, model: str = "l2",
                  min_size: int = 6, deseason: bool = True, pen_mult: float = 4.0):
    """水準の系列（必要なら STL で季節を除く）から、PELT で水準の変わり目（新しい水準が始まる月）を返す。
    pen を省略すると、前月差の標準偏差を使った BIC 型の罰則（× pen_mult）。"""
    import ruptures as rpt
    s = level.dropna().astype(float)
    sa = s - STL(s, period=period, robust=True).fit().seasonal if deseason else s
    x = sa.values.reshape(-1, 1)
    sigma = np.nanstd(np.diff(sa.values)) or 1.0
    if pen is None:
        pen = 2 * np.log(len(x)) * sigma ** 2 * pen_mult
    bk = rpt.Pelt(model=model, min_size=min_size, jump=1).fit(x).predict(pen=pen)
    return [s.index[b] for b in bk[:-1]], sa

title: F22 明日の電力需要を当てる：予測コンペ形式でモデルを競わせる

|---|---|---|

code:
"""01 取得：電力需要（東京・関西）と気象庁の日別値を取ってくる

2026-10-27 にブラウザの中で取得したファイルを data/raw/ に置いています。
ふつうのネット環境なら、このスクリプトで同じものが取れます（サイト側の形式が変わったら直してください）。

- 東京電力パワーグリッド「エリア需給実績データ」
  - 2016〜2023年度：https://www.tepco.co.jp/forecast/html/images/area-YYYY.csv（1時間ごと、単位 万kWh、数字にカンマあり）
  - 2024年2月以降：https://www.tepco.co.jp/forecast/html/images/eria_jukyu_YYYYMM_03.csv（30分ごと、単位 MW 平均）
- 関西電力送配電「エリア需給実績」
  - 2024年4月以降：https://www.kansai-td.co.jp/interchange/denkiyoho/area-performance/eria_jukyu_YYYYMM_06.csv
- 気象庁「過去の気象データ検索」日ごとの値（東京 prec_no=44 block_no=47662、大阪 prec_no=62 block_no=47772）
  - https://www.data.jma.go.jp/stats/etrn/view/daily_s1.php?prec_no=..&block_no=..&year=..&month=..&day=&view=
"""
import time
import io
import requests
import pandas as pd
from common import RAW

S = requests.Session()
S.headers["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (research script)"


def sjis(url):
    r = S.get(url, timeout=60)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.content.decode("shift_jis", errors="replace")


def tepco():
    old = []
    for y in range(2016, 2024):
        t = sjis(f"https://www.tepco.co.jp/forecast/html/images/area-{y}.csv")
        old += [l for l in t.splitlines() if l[:4].isdigit()]
    (RAW / "tepco_area_2016_2023.csv").write_text("\n".join(old) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    rows = []
    for ym in pd.period_range("2024-02", pd.Timestamp.today().strftime("%Y-%m"), freq="M"):
        try:
            t = sjis(f"https://www.tepco.co.jp/forecast/html/images/eria_jukyu_{ym.strftime('%Y%m')}_03.csv")
        except requests.HTTPError:
            continue
        for l in t.splitlines():
            c = l.split(",")
            if c[0][:4].isdigit():
                rows.append((c[0], int(c[1].split(":")[0]), float(c[2])))
        time.sleep(1)
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["date", "hour", "mw"]).groupby(["date", "hour"], sort=False)["mw"].mean().round()
    df.rename("demand_mw").reset_index().to_csv(RAW / "tepco_monthly_2024on_hourly.csv", index=False)


def kansai():
    out = []
    for ym in pd.period_range("2024-04", pd.Timestamp.today().strftime("%Y-%m"), freq="M"):
        try:
            t = sjis(f"https://www.kansai-td.co.jp/interchange/denkiyoho/area-performance/eria_jukyu_{ym.strftime('%Y%m')}_06.csv")
        except requests.HTTPError:
            continue
        out += [l for l in t.splitlines() if l[:4].isdigit()]
        time.sleep(1)
    (RAW / "kansai_area_2024on.csv").write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def jma():
    lines = ["station,date,temp_mean,temp_max,temp_min,humid_mean,sunshine_h,precip_mm"]
    for name, p, b in [("tokyo", 44, 47662), ("osaka", 62, 47772)]:
        for ym in pd.period_range("2016-04", "2026-09", freq="M"):
            url = (f"https://www.data.jma.go.jp/stats/etrn/view/daily_s1.php?prec_no={p}&block_no={b}"
                   f"&year={ym.year}&month={ym.month}&day=&view=")
            tab = pd.read_html(io.StringIO(S.get(url, timeout=60).text), attrs={"id": "tablefix1"})[0]
            for _, r in tab.iterrows():
                d = str(r.iloc[0])
                if not d.isdigit():
                    continue
                v = [str(r.iloc[i]).replace(")", "").replace("]", "").strip() for i in (6, 7, 8, 9, 16, 3)]
                lines.append(f"{name},{ym.year}-{ym.month:02d}-{int(d):02d}," + ",".join(v))
            time.sleep(1)
    (RAW / "jma_daily_tokyo_osaka.csv").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    tepco(); kansai(); jma()

"""02 整形：1時間ごとの需要（MW）と、日ごとの気象・暦の表を作る"""
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import holidays
from common import RAW, DATA

END = "2026-09-30"


def tepco():
    old = pd.read_csv(RAW / "tepco_area_2016_2023.csv", header=None, usecols=[0, 1, 2],
                      names=["date", "time", "v"], dtype=str)
    old["mw"] = old["v"].str.replace(",", "").astype(float) * 10  # 万kWh/時 → MW
    old["hour"] = old["time"].str.split(":").str[0].astype(int)
    old["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(old["date"]) + pd.to_timedelta(old["hour"], unit="h")
    new = pd.read_csv(RAW / "tepco_monthly_2024on_hourly.csv")
    new["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(new["date"]) + pd.to_timedelta(new["hour"], unit="h")
    new["mw"] = new["demand_mw"]
    s = pd.concat([old.loc[old.ts < "2024-02-01", ["ts", "mw"]], new[["ts", "mw"]]]).set_index("ts")["mw"]
    return s[~s.index.duplicated()].sort_index()


def kansai():
    k = pd.read_csv(RAW / "kansai_area_2024on.csv", header=None, usecols=[0, 1, 2],
                    names=["date", "time", "mw"])
    k["hour"] = k["time"].str.split(":").str[0].astype(int)
    k["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(k["date"]) + pd.to_timedelta(k["hour"], unit="h")
    return k.groupby("ts")["mw"].mean().round()


def weather():
    w = pd.read_csv(RAW / "jma_daily_tokyo_osaka.csv", na_values=["///", "×", ""])
    w["precip_mm"] = pd.to_numeric(w["precip_mm"].replace("--", "0"), errors="coerce")
    w["date"] = pd.to_datetime(w["date"])
    return w


def build(series, wx, area):
    idx = pd.date_range(series.index.min().normalize(), END + " 23:00", freq="h")
    d = pd.DataFrame({"demand": series.reindex(idx)})
    d["date"] = d.index.normalize()
    d["hour"] = d.index.hour
    w = wx.set_index("date")[["temp_mean", "temp_max", "temp_min", "humid_mean", "precip_mm"]]
    d = d.join(w, on="date")
    jp = holidays.Japan(years=range(2015, 2028))
    d["holiday"] = d["date"].map(lambda x: x in jp).astype(int)
    d["holiday_name"] = d["date"].map(lambda x: jp.get(x, ""))
    d["area"] = area
    return d


if __name__ == "__main__":
    wx = weather()
    t = build(tepco(), wx[wx.station == "tokyo"], "東京")
    k = build(kansai(), wx[wx.station == "osaka"], "関西")
    for name, d in [("hourly_tokyo.csv", t), ("hourly_kansai.csv", k)]:
        d.index.name = "ts"
        d.to_csv(DATA / name)
        print(name, len(d), "需要の欠け", int(d.demand.isna().sum()), "気温の欠け", int(d.temp_mean.isna().sum()),
              d.index.min(), d.index.max())
    # 古い形式と新しい形式のつなぎ目の確認（2024年1月と2月の平均）
    print(t.loc["2023-12":"2024-03", "demand"].resample("MS").mean().round())

"""03 分析：ベースライン → 線形回帰 → LightGBM を、年度ごとの拡張ウィンドウで比べる（東京エリア）"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
import shap
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from common import DATA, RES, SEED, MODEL_NAMES
from feat import make_features, ridge_matrix, LGB_FEATS

RES.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
LGB_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=900, learning_rate=0.04, num_leaves=63, min_child_samples=40,
                  subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0,
                  random_state=SEED, verbose=-1, n_jobs=4)
FOLDS = [("2020年度", "2020-04-01", "2021-03-31"), ("2021年度", "2021-04-01", "2022-03-31"),
         ("2022年度", "2022-04-01", "2023-03-31"), ("2023年度", "2023-04-01", "2024-03-31"),
         ("2024年度", "2024-04-01", "2025-03-31"), ("2025年度", "2025-04-01", "2026-03-31"),
         ("2026年度上期", "2026-04-01", "2026-09-30")]


def load(name="hourly_tokyo.csv"):
    d = pd.read_csv(DATA / name, index_col="ts", parse_dates=True)
    return make_features(d)


def fit_predict(d, tr, te, feats=LGB_FEATS, models=("naive_week", "naive_day", "ridge", "lgbm")):
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=d.index[te])
    out["actual"] = d.loc[te, "demand"]
    if "naive_week" in models:
        out["naive_week"] = d.loc[te, "lag168"]
    if "naive_day" in models:
        out["naive_day"] = d.loc[te, "lag24"]
    if "ridge" in models:
        Xr = ridge_matrix(d)
        m = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=3.0)).fit(Xr[tr], d.loc[tr, "demand"])
        out["ridge"] = m.predict(Xr[te])
    model = None
    if "lgbm" in models:
        model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**LGB_PARAMS).fit(d.loc[tr, feats], d.loc[tr, "demand"])
        out["lgbm"] = model.predict(d.loc[te, feats])
    return out, model


def scores(p, cols):
    r = {}
    a = p["actual"]
    day = p.index.normalize()
    peak_a = a.groupby(day).max()
    for c in cols:
        ape = (p[c] - a).abs() / a
        peak_p = p[c].groupby(day).max()
        r[c] = {"MAPE(%)": 100 * ape.mean(), "MAE(MW)": (p[c] - a).abs().mean(),
                "ピークのMAPE(%)": 100 * ((peak_p - peak_a).abs() / peak_a).mean(),
                "誤差5%超の時間(%)": 100 * (ape > 0.05).mean()}
    return r


if __name__ == "__main__":
    d = load()
    valid = d["lag168"].notna()
    preds, rows = [], []
    cols = ["naive_week", "naive_day", "ridge", "lgbm"]
    for name, s, e in FOLDS:
        tr = valid & (d.index < s)
        te = valid & (d.index >= s) & (d.index <= e + " 23:00")
        p, model = fit_predict(d, tr, te)
        p["fold"] = name
        preds.append(p)
        for c, v in scores(p, cols).items():
            rows.append({"期間": name, "model": c, **v})
        print(name, {c: round(v["MAPE(%)"], 2) for c, v in scores(p, cols).items()})
    P = pd.concat(preds)
    P.to_csv(RES / "predictions.csv.gz", compression="gzip")
    allsc = scores(P, cols)
    for c, v in allsc.items():
        rows.append({"期間": "全期間（2020年4月〜2026年9月）", "model": c, **v})
    noc = P[P.fold != "2020年度"]
    for c, v in scores(noc, cols).items():
        rows.append({"期間": "2020年度を除く", "model": c, **v})
    M = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    M.to_csv(RES / "metrics.csv", index=False)
    print(M[M.期間.str.startswith("全期間")].round(2))

    # 日ごとの誤差と、外れた日
    a = P["actual"]
    day = P.index.normalize()
    dd = pd.DataFrame({"MAPE_lgbm": 100 * ((P["lgbm"] - a).abs() / a).groupby(day).mean(),
                       "誤差の向き(MW)": (P["lgbm"] - a).groupby(day).mean(),
                       "MAPE_week": 100 * ((P["naive_week"] - a).abs() / a).groupby(day).mean(),
                       "実績の日平均(MW)": a.groupby(day).mean()})
    info = d[d.hour == 12].set_index("date")[["temp_max", "temp_min", "precip_mm", "holiday", "holiday_name", "dow", "nenmatsu", "obon", "gw", "temp_change"]]
    dd = dd.join(info)
    dd.index.name = "date"
    dd.to_csv(RES / "daily_errors.csv")

    hol = set(d.loc[d.holiday == 1, "date"].dt.normalize())
    def near_holiday(x):
        return any((x + pd.Timedelta(days=k)) in hol for k in (-1, 0, 1))
    def label(r):
        x = r.name
        md = (x.month, x.day)
        if (x.month == 12 and x.day >= 26) or (x.month == 1 and x.day <= 5): return "年末年始（12/26〜1/5）"
        if x.month == 8 and 10 <= x.day <= 20: return "お盆の時期（8/10〜8/20）"
        if (x.month == 4 and x.day >= 27) or (x.month == 5 and x.day <= 7): return "大型連休（4/27〜5/7）"
        if near_holiday(x): return "祝日とその前後1日"
        if r.temp_max >= 33: return "猛暑（最高33℃以上）"
        if abs(r.temp_change) >= 5: return "前日から日平均気温が5℃以上変化"
        if r.precip_mm >= 30: return "大雨（日降水量30mm以上）"
        return "その他の日"
    dd["分類"] = dd.apply(label, axis=1)
    worst = dd.sort_values("MAPE_lgbm", ascending=False).head(30)
    worst.to_csv(RES / "worst_days.csv")
    cat = dd.groupby("分類").agg(日数=("MAPE_lgbm", "size"), 平均MAPE=("MAPE_lgbm", "mean"))
    top = dd.sort_values("MAPE_lgbm", ascending=False).head(100)["分類"].value_counts().rename("外れた100日に入った日数")
    cat = cat.join(top).fillna(0)
    cat["全体での割合(%)"] = 100 * cat["日数"] / cat["日数"].sum()
    cat["外れた100日での割合(%)"] = cat["外れた100日に入った日数"]
    cat.sort_values("平均MAPE", ascending=False).to_csv(RES / "error_by_category.csv")
    print(worst.head(15)[["MAPE_lgbm", "誤差の向き(MW)", "temp_max", "temp_change", "分類"]].round(1))
    print(cat.round(2))

    # SHAP（最後の期間のモデル）
    tr = valid & (d.index < "2026-04-01")
    te = valid & (d.index >= "2026-04-01")
    _, model = fit_predict(d, tr, te, models=("lgbm",))
    X = d.loc[te, LGB_FEATS].sample(4000, random_state=SEED)
    sv = shap.TreeExplainer(model).shap_values(X)
    imp = pd.DataFrame({"mean_abs_shap": np.abs(sv).mean(0)}, index=LGB_FEATS).sort_values("mean_abs_shap", ascending=False)
    imp.to_csv(RES / "shap_importance.csv")
    np.save(RES / "_shap_values.npy", sv); X.to_csv(RES / "_shap_X.csv")
    print(imp.round(0).head(12))

"""03b 頑健性：学習の窓・気温の予報誤差・特徴量を抜く・特別な期間の特徴・関西エリア"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from common import DATA, RES, SEED
from feat import make_features, LGB_FEATS, LAG_FEATS, TEMP_FEATS
import importlib
main = importlib.import_module("03_分析")
FOLDS, LGB_PARAMS, scores, fit_predict = main.FOLDS, main.LGB_PARAMS, main.scores, main.fit_predict

raw = pd.read_csv(DATA / "hourly_tokyo.csv", index_col="ts", parse_dates=True)
d = make_features(raw)
valid = d["lag168"].notna()


def add_wide(dd):
    dd = dd.copy()
    m, day = dd.index.month, dd.index.day
    dd["obon_wide"] = ((m == 8) & (day >= 10) & (day <= 20)).astype(int)
    dd["nenmatsu_wide"] = (((m == 12) & (day >= 26)) | ((m == 1) & (day <= 5))).astype(int)
    hol = pd.Series(((dd["holiday"] == 1) | (dd["dow"] >= 5)).groupby(dd["date"]).max())

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager

    if "NotoSansCJK" in f or "Noto Sans CJK" in f:
        font_manager.fontManager.addfont(f)
plt.rcParams["font.family"] = ["Noto Sans CJK JP"]
plt.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False
plt.rcParams["figure.dpi"] = 110

MODEL_NAMES = {
    "naive_week": "1週間前の同じ時刻",
    "naive_day": "前日の同じ時刻",
    "ridge": "線形回帰（Ridge）",
    "lgbm": "LightGBM",
}
COLORS = {"1週間前の同じ時刻": "#9aa0a6", "前日の同じ時刻": "#5f6368",
          "線形回帰（Ridge）": "#1a73e8", "LightGBM": "#188038"}

"""特徴量（予測する日 D の前日 D−1 の夜に、D の24時間分を出す設定）

- 需要は D−1 の23時まで分かっている → 24時間前・168時間前（1週間前）の同じ時刻の値を使える
- 気温は D の日平均・最高・最低を使う（本来は予報値。実測で代用しているので、運用より良く出る）
"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def special_flags(dates):
    m, d = dates.dt.month, dates.dt.day
    nenmatsu = ((m == 12) & (d >= 29)) | ((m == 1) & (d <= 3))
    obon = (m == 8) & (d >= 13) & (d <= 16)
    gw = ((m == 4) & (d >= 29)) | ((m == 5) & (d <= 5))
    return nenmatsu.astype(int), obon.astype(int), gw.astype(int)


def make_features(df, tmean_shift=None):
    d = df.copy()
    d["date"] = pd.to_datetime(d["date"])
    if tmean_shift is not None:  # 気温の予報誤差を足す（頑健性）
        for c in ("temp_mean", "temp_max", "temp_min"):
            d[c] = d[c] + d["date"].map(tmean_shift).fillna(0).values
    d["dow"] = d.index.dayofweek
    d["daytype"] = np.where((d["holiday"] == 1) | (d["dow"] == 6), 2, np.where(d["dow"] == 5, 1, 0))
    d["nenmatsu"], d["obon"], d["gw"] = special_flags(d["date"])
    doy = d.index.dayofyear
    d["doy_sin"], d["doy_cos"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * doy / 365.25), np.cos(2 * np.pi * doy / 365.25)
    d["month"] = d.index.month
    d["year"] = d.index.year + (d.index.dayofyear / 366)
    d["cdd"] = (d["temp_mean"] - 22).clip(lower=0)
    d["hdd"] = (16 - d["temp_mean"]).clip(lower=0)
    d["cdd_max"] = (d["temp_max"] - 28).clip(lower=0)
    d["lag24"] = d["demand"].shift(24)
    d["lag168"] = d["demand"].shift(168)
    daily = d["demand"].resample("D").mean()
    d["prevday_mean"] = d["date"].map(daily.shift(1))
    dt = d["temp_mean"].resample("D").first()
    d["temp_prev"] = d["date"].map(dt.shift(1))
    d["temp_change"] = d["temp_mean"] - d["temp_prev"]
    d["lag24_daytype"] = d["daytype"].shift(24)
    return d


LGB_FEATS = ["hour", "dow", "daytype", "holiday", "nenmatsu", "obon", "gw", "doy_sin", "doy_cos", "month", "year",
             "temp_mean", "temp_max", "temp_min", "humid_mean", "cdd", "hdd", "cdd_max", "temp_change",
             "lag24", "lag168", "prevday_mean", "lag24_daytype"]
LAG_FEATS = ["lag24", "lag168", "prevday_mean", "lag24_daytype"]
TEMP_FEATS = ["temp_mean", "temp_max", "temp_min", "humid_mean", "cdd", "hdd", "cdd_max", "temp_change"]


def ridge_matrix(d):
    """線形回帰用：時刻×曜日区分のダミー、時刻帯×冷暖房度日、ラグ"""
    X = pd.get_dummies(d["hour"].astype(str) + "_" + d["daytype"].astype(str), prefix="hd", dtype=float)
    blk = pd.cut(d["hour"], [-1, 5, 11, 17, 23], labels=["n", "m", "a", "e"]).astype(str)
    for b in ["n", "m", "a", "e"]:
        on = (blk == b).astype(float)
        for c in ("cdd", "hdd", "cdd_max"):
            X[f"{c}_{b}"] = on * d[c]
            X[f"{c}2_{b}"] = on * d[c] ** 2
    for c in ("nenmatsu", "obon", "gw", "doy_sin", "doy_cos", "year", "humid_mean", "temp_change"):
        X[c] = d[c]
    X["lag24"] = d["lag24"] * (d["daytype"] == d["lag24_daytype"])
    X["lag24_diff_type"] = d["lag24"] * (d["daytype"] != d["lag24_daytype"])
    X["lag168"] = d["lag168"]
    X["prevday_mean"] = d["prevday_mean"]
    return X

title: F23 救急車をどこに置けば、到着が早くなるか？（福井市・数理最適化）
data_sec:
| データ | 内容 | 出典 |
|---|---|---|
| 需要（人口） | 国勢調査 2020年 500mメッシュ「人口及び世帯」（T001141、1次メッシュ5336・5436）。福井市の境界の中で人口のある898メッシュ、計262,330人（65歳以上75,577人） | 総務省統計局（e-Stat 統計地理情報システム） |

| 市の境界 | 行政区域（2021年）の簡略版 TopoJSON | smartnews-smri/japan-topography（国土数値情報をもとに作成、CC BY 4.0） |

候補地は、今の21か所と、1kmの格子（3次メッシュ）ごとにいちばん人口の多い500mメッシュの中心340か所の計361か所。

- 実際の現場到着時間ではない。渋滞・信号・同時出動・救急車の台数（1か所に何台あるか）・出動件数の地域差は入れていない。OSRM の所要時間は渋滞なしの目安
- 消防署の位置は2012年のデータ。その後の移転・統合は反映していない
